answer: Fingerprint escrow: a new agent locks 40 POA and records a fingerprint of timing and cadence on a jade token. Honest agents wander; that wandering is the print. Each epoch an audit checks behavior against the print; a mismatch freezes the escrow and the slash ripples to linked accounts. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA plus 1,000 fake prints against a 30,000 pool - a loss. One honest agent pays once, keeps its full share.
